data.field_of_study: Students in all fields of graduate study eligible if their program is eligible for Tri-Agency funding
data.other_hard: Must be recommended by their department or unit; Tri-Agency eligible program; Show great promise as researchers and graduate students
data.evidence_sentence: All students regardless of citizenship are eligible to apply.
data.notes: Award is a university-wide fellowship recommended by departments; the page says to contact departments for their application process and deadline, so no fixed deadline is stated. Funding is a fixed annual amount ($20,000 master's, $25,000 doctoral), so classed as partial. Minimum GPA of 3.0 is an admission criterion; departments may set higher GPA requirements. Continuing GPA of 3.0 with grade no lower than C+ and full-time registration are conditions to keep the award. Page states it is not a complete list of conditions. Page title says UMGF while the name given is University of Manitoba Graduate Scholarship; the page describes the fellowship.
